wrist_image_domain: recorded pre-cropped 128x128 RGB policy ROI, not full camera frames
contour_method: Manual fixed ROI/seed prior, per-image GrabCut and green HSV mask; conservative top-boundary heuristic; visibly imperfect near occlusion
recorded_pose_frame: base_link as required by original EEF decoder
recorded_pose_representation: xyz in meters plus quaternion xyzw; exported RPY uses extrinsic fixed XYZ Euler degrees
reason: Current contour alone is not a reliable 6D pose; calibration-version/source-image-size confirmation and visible 2D-3D correspondences or a calibrated hand-eye/grasp transform are needed
important_observation: EEF pitch changes in base frame do not imply equal changes of module pitch relative to a co-moving wrist camera; occlusion and grasp motion must be distinguished
